errors.text_span: “另行收购”、“质押质押”、“服务收购”、“企业收购”、“高等教育”、“解禁质押”、“公司上市”、“企业融资”、“企业融资”、“被动资产”和“被动资产”
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies most of the x-axis labels. For example, it lists “另行收购” (another acquisition) instead of “亏损” (loss), “质押质押” (pledge pledge) instead of “质押” (pledge), “高等教育” (higher education) instead of “高管变动” (executive change), and “被动资产” (passive assets) instead of “企业破产” (corporate bankruptcy) and “被约谈” (being summoned for talks). It also omits several categories shown in the chart, such as “中标” (winning bid).
The bars are not sorted alphabetically. They are sorted in descending order based on their value on the y-axis.
The vertical axis scale extends to 300, not 250.
The vertical axis does not have a label. The text '验证集' (validation set) is the label for the legend, not the axis.

errors.text_span: 代表验证集中所有事件类型的总数
errors.evidence: The bar chart does not represent the total number of all event types. Each individual bar represents the count for a single event type within the validation set.
The height of the longest bar ('股份回购') is approximately 245, not 250.
The description implies the highest tick value is 250, but the highest labeled tick on the axis is 300.

errors.text_span: 其高度分别为“另行收购”为 160、 “质押质押”为 130、 “服务收购”为 110、 “企业收购”为 110、 “高等教育”为 90、 “解禁质押”为 80、 “公司上市”为 70、 “企业融资”为 60、 “被动资产”为 60 和“被动资产”为 50
errors.evidence: Nearly all numerical values reported for the bars are incorrect. For example, the second bar ('亏损') is at ~165 (reported as 160), the third bar ('质押') is at ~160 (reported as 130), and the fourth bar ('股东减持') is at ~148 (reported as 110).

errors.text_span: 图表未按特定方式排序
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. The bars are clearly sorted in descending order of their values. This also contradicts the earlier incorrect claim of alphabetical sorting.
